content: User prefers concise explanations, small diffs, and direct answers.
Tests use node:test. Do not add Jest or another test runner.
Use Node's built-in node:sqlite module instead of a native SQLite addon, so install does not need a compiler.
Default search is hybrid: SQLite FTS5 keywords plus a local hash embedding. HTTP embeddings are optional.
Memories are stored in a local SQLite file. The default path is ~/.agent-memory/memory.db.
memory_clear only previews a delete until the caller sends the confirmation phrase it was given. Do not store secrets in memory.
